// SIMT GEMM: a workgroup scores 64 corpus rows against 8–64 queries. Corpus
// components enter LDS once in FP16 and expand to FP32 in registers. Queries
// and accumulation remain FP32; components accumulate in increasing order.
amdgpu.target<gfx1151> @target {subgroup_size = 32}
config.decl @db.batch : %value: index where [range(%value, 8, 64), mul(%value, 8)]
config.decl @db.scan.dimensions : %value: index where [range(%value, 128, 16384), mul(%value, 128)]
kernel.def target(@target) export("batch_scan") @batch_scan(%count_arg: i32) {
  %one = index.constant 1 : index
  %four = index.constant 4 : index
  %rows = index.constant 64 : index
  %extra = index.constant 63 : index
  %batch = config.get @db.batch : index
  %threads = index.mul %batch, %four : index
  %raw = index.cast %count_arg : i32 to index
  %count = index.assume %raw [range(%raw, 1, 262144)] : index
  %rounded = index.add %count, %extra : index
  %groups = index.div %rounded, %rows : index
  kernel.launch.config workgroups(%groups, %one, %one) workgroup_size(%threads, %one, %one) : index
} launch(%count_arg: i32, %masked_arg: i32, %row_base_arg: i32, %total_arg: i32, %data: buffer, %queries: buffer, %norms: buffer, %bitmap: buffer, %scores: buffer) {
  %zero = index.constant 0 : offset
  %i0 = index.constant 0 : index
  %i1 = index.constant 1 : index
  %i4 = index.constant 4 : index
  %i8 = index.constant 8 : index
  %c32 = index.constant 32 : index
  %c64 = index.constant 64 : index
  %c68 = index.constant 68 : index
  %c512 = index.constant 512 : index
  %batch = config.get @db.batch : index
  %d = config.get @db.scan.dimensions : index
  %threads = index.mul %batch, %i4 : index
  %query_groups = index.div %batch, %i4 : index
  %raw = index.cast %count_arg : i32 to index
  %count = index.assume %raw [range(%raw, 1, 262144)] : index
  %tid0 = kernel.workitem.id<x> : index
  %tid = index.assume %tid0 [range(%tid0, 0, 255)] : index
  %group0 = kernel.workgroup.id<x> : index
  %group = index.assume %group0 [range(%group0, 0, 4095)] : index
  %row_base = index.mul %group, %c64 : index
  %row_group = index.div %tid, %query_groups : index
  %query_group = index.rem %tid, %query_groups : index
  %local_row_base = index.mul %row_group, %i4 : index
  %local_query_base = index.mul %query_group, %i4 : index
  %dv = buffer.view %data[%zero] : buffer -> view<[%count]x[%d]xf16>
  %qv = buffer.view %queries[%zero] : buffer -> view<[%d]x[%batch]xf32>
  %nv = buffer.view %norms[%zero] : buffer -> view<[%count]xf32>
  %sv = buffer.view %scores[%zero] : buffer -> view<[%batch]x[%count]xf32>
  %xbytes = index.constant 4352 : offset
  %query_words = index.mul %c32, %batch : index
  %four_offset = index.constant 4 : offset
  %qbytes = index.scale %query_words, %four_offset : index, offset -> offset
  %xscratch = buffer.alloca<workgroup> align(16) %xbytes : buffer
  %qscratch = buffer.alloca<workgroup> align(16) %qbytes : buffer
  // Padding breaks bank conflicts when transposing corpus components into LDS.
  %xs = buffer.view %xscratch[%zero] : buffer -> view<32x68xf16>
  %qs = buffer.view %qscratch[%zero] : buffer -> view<32x[%batch]xf32>
  %f0 = scalar.constant 0.0 : f32
  %initial = vector.splat %f0 : vector<16xf32>
  %query_vectors = index.mul %i8, %batch : index
  %accumulated = scf.for %base = [%i0 to %d step %c32](%acc = %initial : vector<16xf32>) -> (vector<16xf32>) {
    // Exact trip counts let the compiler unroll cooperative staging. Both
    // widths divide the number of four-component corpus/query loads.
    %x_iterations = index.div %c512, %threads : index
    scf.for %xi = [%i0 to %x_iterations step %i1] unroll {
      %xstep = index.mul %xi, %threads : index
      %v = index.add %tid, %xstep : index
      %r = index.div %v, %i8 : index
      %column_group = index.rem %v, %i8 : index
      %column = index.mul %column_group, %i4 : index
      %row = index.add %row_base, %r : index
      %valid = index.cmp ult, %row, %count : index
      %safe = scf.select %valid, %row, %i0 : index
      %at = index.assume %safe [range(%safe, 0, 262143), lt(%safe, %count)] : index
      %dim = index.add %base, %column : index
      %values = vector.load %dv[%at, %dim] : view<[%count]x[%d]xf16> -> vector<4xf16>
      scf.for %j = [%i0 to %i4 step %i1] unroll {
        %col = index.add %column, %j : index
        %value = vector.extract %values[%j] : vector<4xf16> -> f16
        view.store %value, %xs[%col, %r] : f16, view<32x68xf16>
      }
    }
    %q_iterations = index.div %query_vectors, %threads : index
    scf.for %qi = [%i0 to %q_iterations step %i1] unroll {
      %qstep = index.mul %qi, %threads : index
      %v = index.add %tid, %qstep : index
      %col = index.div %v, %query_groups : index
      %qgroup = index.rem %v, %query_groups : index
      %q = index.mul %qgroup, %i4 : index
      %dim = index.add %base, %col : index
      %values = vector.load %qv[%dim, %q] : view<[%d]x[%batch]xf32> -> vector<4xf32>
      vector.store %values, %qs[%col, %q] : vector<4xf32>, view<32x[%batch]xf32>
    }
    kernel.barrier<workgroup> scope(workgroup) ordering(acq_rel)
    %dot_width = index.constant 4 : index
    // Ordered products share each incoming accumulator. After the first
    // FMA, dot-local accumulators permit compact and paired FMAC instructions.
    %empty_tile = vector.splat %f0 : vector<4x4xf32>
    %empty_dot = vector.splat %f0 : vector<4xf32>
    %next = scf.for %col = [%i0 to %c32 step %dot_width](%values = %acc : vector<16xf32>) -> (vector<16xf32>) unroll {
      %xt, %qt = scf.for %j = [%i0 to %dot_width step %i1](%xts = %empty_tile : vector<4x4xf32>, %qts = %empty_tile : vector<4x4xf32>) -> (vector<4x4xf32>, vector<4x4xf32>) unroll {
        %column = index.add %col, %j : index
        %halves = vector.load %xs[%column, %local_row_base] : view<32x68xf16> -> vector<4xf16>
        %xvalues = vector.extf %halves : vector<4xf16> to vector<4xf32>
        %qvalues = vector.load %qs[%column, %local_query_base] : view<32x[%batch]xf32> -> vector<4xf32>
        %new_x = vector.insert %xvalues into %xts[%j] : vector<4xf32>, vector<4x4xf32>
        %new_q = vector.insert %qvalues into %qts[%j] : vector<4xf32>, vector<4x4xf32>
        scf.yield %new_x, %new_q : vector<4x4xf32>, vector<4x4xf32>
      }
      %updated = scf.for %r = [%i0 to %i4 step %i1](%rs = %values : vector<16xf32>) -> (vector<16xf32>) unroll {
        %rbase = index.mul %r, %i4 : index
        %vx = scf.for %j = [%i0 to %dot_width step %i1](%xv = %empty_dot : vector<4xf32>) -> (vector<4xf32>) unroll {
          %x = vector.extract %xt[%j, %r] : vector<4x4xf32> -> f32
          %new_x = vector.insert %x into %xv[%j] : f32, vector<4xf32>
          scf.yield %new_x : vector<4xf32>
        }
        %new_row = scf.for %q = [%i0 to %i4 step %i1](%sums = %rs : vector<16xf32>) -> (vector<16xf32>) unroll {
          %vy = scf.for %j = [%i0 to %dot_width step %i1](%qvec = %empty_dot : vector<4xf32>) -> (vector<4xf32>) unroll {
            %y = vector.extract %qt[%j, %q] : vector<4x4xf32> -> f32
            %new_y = vector.insert %y into %qvec[%j] : f32, vector<4xf32>
            scf.yield %new_y : vector<4xf32>
          }
          %slot = index.add %rbase, %q : index
          %old = vector.extract %sums[%slot] : vector<16xf32> -> f32
          %sum = vector.dotf %vx, %vy, %old : vector<4xf32>, vector<4xf32>, f32
          %inserted = vector.insert %sum into %sums[%slot] : f32, vector<16xf32>
          scf.yield %inserted : vector<16xf32>
        }
        scf.yield %new_row : vector<16xf32>
      }
      scf.yield %updated : vector<16xf32>
    }
    kernel.barrier<workgroup> scope(workgroup) ordering(acq_rel)
    scf.yield %next : vector<16xf32>
  }
  %zero_i32 = scalar.constant 0 : i32
  %masked = scalar.cmpi ne, %masked_arg, %zero_i32 : i32
  %c31 = index.constant 31 : index
  %total0 = index.cast %total_arg : i32 to index
  %total = index.assume %total0 [range(%total0, 1, 1073741824)] : index
  %global_base0 = index.cast %row_base_arg : i32 to index
  %global_base = index.assume %global_base0 [range(%global_base0, 0, 1073741823)] : index
  %rounded = index.add %total, %c31 : index
  %words = index.div %rounded, %c32 : index
  %bv = buffer.view %bitmap[%zero] : buffer -> view<[%words]xi32>
  scf.for %r = [%i0 to %i4 step %i1] unroll {
    %local = index.add %local_row_base, %r : index
    %row = index.add %row_base, %local : index
    %valid = index.cmp ult, %row, %count : index
    scf.if %valid {
      %at = index.assume %row [range(%row, 0, 262143), lt(%row, %count)] : index
      %inverse = view.load %nv[%at] : view<[%count]xf32> -> f32
      %excluded = scf.if %masked -> (i1) {
        %global0 = index.add %global_base, %at : index
        %global = index.assume %global0 [range(%global0, 0, 1073741823), lt(%global0, %total)] : index
        %word0 = index.div %global, %c32 : index
        %word = index.assume %word0 [range(%word0, 0, 33554431), lt(%word0, %words)] : index
        %bit = index.rem %global, %c32 : index
        %bits = view.load %bv[%word] : view<[%words]xi32> -> i32
        %shift = index.cast %bit : index to i32
        %shifted = scalar.shrui %bits, %shift : i32
        %one = scalar.constant 1 : i32
        %flag = scalar.andi %shifted, %one : i32
        %test = scalar.cmpi ne, %flag, %zero_i32 : i32
        scf.yield %test : i1
      } else {
        %no = scalar.constant false : i1
        scf.yield %no : i1
      }
      %rbase = index.mul %r, %i4 : index
      scf.for %q = [%i0 to %i4 step %i1] unroll {
        %query = index.add %local_query_base, %q : index
        %slot = index.add %rbase, %q : index
        %sum = vector.extract %accumulated[%slot] : vector<16xf32> -> f32
        %cosine = scalar.mulf %sum, %inverse : f32
        %badbits = scalar.constant -8388608 : i32
        %neg = scalar.bitcast %badbits : i32 to f32
        %score = scf.select %excluded, %neg, %cosine : f32
        view.store %score, %sv[%query, %at] : f32, view<[%batch]x[%count]xf32>
      }
    }
  }
  kernel.return
}

      scf.for %r = [%i0 to %i4 step %i1] unroll {
        %row = index.add %first_row, %r : index
        %valid = index.cmp ult, %row, %count : index
        scf.if %valid {
          %out = index.assume %row [range(%row, 0, 262143), lt(%row, %count)] : index
          %value = vector.extract %four_scores[%r] : vector<4xf32> -> f32
          view.store %value, %sv[%query, %out] : f32, view<[%batch]x[%count]xf32>
        }
      }
    }
  }
  kernel.return
}

  %accumulated = scf.for %base = [%i0 to %d step %c32](%acc = %initial : vector<16xf32>) -> (vector<16xf32>) {

    // widths divide the number of four-component corpus/query loads.

    scf.for %xi = [%i0 to %x_iterations step %i1] unroll {

      %v = index.add %tid, %xstep : index
      %r = index.div %v, %i8 : index
      %column_group = index.rem %v, %i8 : index
      %column = index.mul %column_group, %i4 : index
      %row = index.add %row_base, %r : index
      %valid = index.cmp ult, %row, %count : index
      %safe = scf.select %valid, %row, %i0 : index
      %at = index.assume %safe [range(%safe, 0, 262143), lt(%safe, %count)] : index

      scf.for %j = [%i0 to %i4 step %i1] unroll {

        %value = vector.extract %values[%j] : vector<4xf16> -> f16
        view.store %value, %xs[%col, %r] : f16, view<32x68xf16>

    scf.for %qi = [%i0 to %q_iterations step %i1] unroll {
      %qstep = index.mul %qi, %threads : index
      %v = index.add %tid, %qstep : index
      %col = index.div %v, %query_groups : index
      %qgroup = index.rem %v, %query_groups : index
      %q = index.mul %qgroup, %i4 : index
      %dim = index.add %base, %col : index
      %values = vector.load %qv[%dim, %q] : view<[%d]x[%batch]xf32> -> vector<4xf32>
      vector.store %values, %qs[%col, %q] : vector<4xf32>, view<32x[%batch]xf32>
    }
    kernel.barrier<workgroup> scope(workgroup) ordering(acq_rel)
    // Eight ordered products share each incoming accumulator. After the first
    // FMA, dot-local accumulators permit compact and paired FMAC instructions.
    %empty_tile = vector.splat %f0 : vector<8x4xf32>
    %empty_dot = vector.splat %f0 : vector<8xf32>
    %next = scf.for %col = [%i0 to %c32 step %i8](%values = %acc : vector<16xf32>) -> (vector<16xf32>) unroll {
      %xt, %qt = scf.for %j = [%i0 to %i8 step %i1](%xts = %empty_tile : vector<8x4xf32>, %qts = %empty_tile : vector<8x4xf32>) -> (vector<8x4xf32>, vector<8x4xf32>) unroll {
        %column = index.add %col, %j : index
        %halves = vector.load %xs[%column, %local_row_base] : view<32x68xf16> -> vector<4xf16>
        %xvalues = vector.extf %halves : vector<4xf16> to vector<4xf32>
        %qvalues = vector.load %qs[%column, %local_query_base] : view<32x[%batch]xf32> -> vector<4xf32>
        %new_x = vector.insert %xvalues into %xts[%j] : vector<4xf32>, vector<8x4xf32>
        %new_q = vector.insert %qvalues into %qts[%j] : vector<4xf32>, vector<8x4xf32>

          %new_x = vector.insert %x into %xv[%j] : f32, vector<8xf32>
          scf.yield %new_x : vector<8xf32>
        }
        %new_row = scf.for %q = [%i0 to %i4 step %i1](%sums = %rs : vector<16xf32>) -> (vector<16xf32>) unroll {
          %vy = scf.for %j = [%i0 to %i8 step %i1](%qvec = %empty_dot : vector<8xf32>) -> (vector<8xf32>) unroll {

            %new_y = vector.insert %y into %qvec[%j] : f32, vector<8xf32>
            scf.yield %new_y : vector<8xf32>

          scf.yield %inserted : vector<16xf32>

      }
      scf.yield %updated : vector<16xf32>
    }
    kernel.barrier<workgroup> scope(workgroup) ordering(acq_rel)
    scf.yield %next : vector<16xf32>
  }

  %masked = scalar.cmpi ne, %masked_arg, %zero_i32 : i32
  %c31 = index.constant 31 : index
  %total0 = index.cast %total_arg : i32 to index
  %total = index.assume %total0 [range(%total0, 1, 1073741824)] : index
  %global_base0 = index.cast %row_base_arg : i32 to index
  %global_base = index.assume %global_base0 [range(%global_base0, 0, 1073741823)] : index

  %words = index.div %rounded, %c32 : index

  %empty_mask = vector.splat %zero_i32 : vector<4xi32>

      %valid = index.cmp ult, %row, %count : index
      %inverse = scf.if %valid -> (f32) {
        %at = index.assume %row [range(%row, 0, 262143), lt(%row, %count)] : index
        %inv = view.load %nv[%at] : view<[%count]xf32> -> f32
        scf.yield %inv : f32
      } else {
        scf.yield %f0 : f32
      }
      %updated = vector.insert %inverse into %ns[%r] : f32, vector<4xf32>
      scf.yield %updated : vector<4xf32>
    }
    scf.yield %norms : vector<4xf32>
  }

    %flags = scf.for %r = [%i0 to %i4 step %i1](%ms = %empty_mask : vector<4xi32>) -> (vector<4xi32>) unroll {
      %row = index.add %first_row, %r : index
      %valid = index.cmp ult, %row, %count : index
      %flag = scf.if %valid -> (i32) {

        %global0 = index.add %global_base, %at : index
        %global = index.assume %global0 [range(%global0, 0, 1073741823), lt(%global0, %total)] : index

        %word = index.assume %word0 [range(%word0, 0, 33554431), lt(%word0, %words)] : index

        %bits = view.load %bv[%word] : view<[%words]xi32> -> i32

        %shifted = scalar.shrui %bits, %shift : i32
        %one = scalar.constant 1 : i32
        %flag = scalar.andi %shifted, %one : i32
        scf.yield %flag : i32
      } else {
        scf.yield %zero_i32 : i32
      }
      %updated = vector.insert %flag into %ms[%r] : i32, vector<4xi32>
      scf.yield %updated : vector<4xi32>
    }
    scf.yield %flags : vector<4xi32>
  } else {
    scf.yield %empty_mask : vector<4xi32>
  }
  %badbits = scalar.constant -8388608 : i32
  %neg = scalar.bitcast %badbits : i32 to f32
  %negs = vector.splat %neg : vector<4xf32>
  scf.for %q = [%i0 to %i4 step %i1] unroll {
    %query = index.add %local_query_base, %q : index
    %four_sums = scf.for %r = [%i0 to %i4 step %i1](%vs = %empty_norms : vector<4xf32>) -> (vector<4xf32>) unroll {
      %rbase = index.mul %r, %i4 : index
      %slot = index.add %rbase, %q : index
      %value = vector.extract %accumulated[%slot] : vector<16xf32> -> f32
      %updated = vector.insert %value into %vs[%r] : f32, vector<4xf32>
      scf.yield %updated : vector<4xf32>
    }
    %cosines = vector.mulf %four_sums, %inverses : vector<4xf32>
    %excluded_flags = vector.cmpi ne, %excluded_rows, %empty_mask : vector<4xi32> -> vector<4xi1>
    %four_scores = vector.select %excluded_flags, %negs, %cosines : vector<4xf32>
    scf.if %full {
      %out = index.assume %first_row [range(%first_row, 0, 262140), lt(%first_row, %count)] : index
      vector.store %four_scores, %sv[%query, %out] : vector<4xf32>, view<[%batch]x[%count]xf32>
    } else {
      scf.for %r = [%i0 to %i4 step %i1] unroll {
        %row = index.add %first_row, %r : index
        %valid = index.cmp ult, %row, %count : index
        scf.if %valid {
          %out = index.assume %row [range(%row, 0, 262143), lt(%row, %count)] : index
          %value = vector.extract %four_scores[%r] : vector<4xf32> -> f32
          view.store %value, %sv[%query, %out] : f32, view<[%batch]x[%count]xf32>
        }
      }
    }
  }
